description: This file contains unit tests for the BaseCustomizableMetadata class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing attribute setting behavior in Provider entities within the context of the OpenMRS API.

classes.name: BaseCustomizableMetadataTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class extending BaseContextSensitiveTest to verify behavior of setting attributes on Provider objects, including handling of attribute maxOccurs and data types.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Initializes the ProviderService and loads test datasets before each test execution.

methods.name: setAttribute_shouldVoidTheAttributeIfAnAttributeWithSameAttributeTypeAlreadyExistsAndTheMaxOccursIsSetTo1
methods.description: Tests that setting an attribute of a provider correctly voids existing attributes of the same type when maxOccurs is 1.

methods.name: setAttribute_shouldWorkForAttriubutesWithDatatypesWhoseValuesAreStoredInOtherTables
methods.description: Verifies that setting attributes with complex data types stored in other tables behaves correctly with attribute creation and voiding.

methods.name: buildProviderAttribute
methods.description: Helper method to construct ProviderAttribute objects with specified attribute types and values.
